authorization: 2026-10-17 owner: local coherent refinement implementation and one bounded cached comparison; no cloud
confirmation: oral-GSA unchanged/unacquired; source/genome/replicon/taxonomy/overlap/truth and separate cost admission before later acquisition/execution; October21 storage review unchanged

criteria.abandon: reject current selection policy if it systematically harms recovery/full-DNA accounting; never discard marker information or a feature family from one sample
criteria.keep: Engineering/full-DNA contracts pass, weighted full-reference R95 >= protected CPM and targets>=50% >= protected CPM; report every target loss and N/length/origin trade-off. Equality supports safety only, not a performance gain.
criteria.modify: Any protected-CPM recovery or >=50%-target decline keeps the rule experimental; preserve losses and inspect proxy limitations without changing this run. A mixed trade-off needs an explicit later decision, not post-score tuning.
criteria.saturation: a small/null/inconsistent gain should trigger additional-data admission and a reviewed training/representation decision rather than indefinite tuning to E009

evaluation.controls: E012 protected CPM (exact native parent) and E011 old CPM refinement, preserved dev3 contextual only; no repeat fit/scoring of immutable controls
evaluation.denominators: 145702 contigs /231678157bp; 156 primary targets /554661890 provided bp; all short/marker-negative/non-target/unknown populations
metrics: full-reference weighted/macro R95 at 200kb/95% all-bin purity
restricted B3, unchanged native neighbor diagnostics
evaluation.truth: admitted conservative E009 v2, separate process after selected outputs seal

question: Can call reliability, conservative median seeding and quality/context selection retain useful marker refinements without destructive duplicate-count splits?

resources.expected_seconds: 2-6 minutes refinement/verification/review; timeout is not prediction

rule.acceptance: full-parent-bp-weighted child marker-quality strictly improves parent beyond eight ULP; unassigned DNA contributes its unchanged parent quality. Require positive native cosine leave-one-out centroid silhouette and positive composition OR available depth context, each beyond 64 machine eps
rule.alternatives: whole CPM parent, exact retained adopted old children/noise, and at most one new supported median-seeded candidate per parent; no grid
rule.call_weights: coverage * (1 - 2**(-max(0, domain_bits - trusted_domain_cutoff))); partial gene calls multiply another coverage factor; heuristic, not probability
rule.context: bp-weighted leave-one-out centroid silhouettes, full-parent bp denominator; unassigned=-1, missing information=0; composition sqrt TNF, depth log1p measured parent means divided by global eligible column std, constant columns/all-zero rows no support; not per-base/window coverage variance
rule.data_boundary: selector has no truth/reference genome/taxon/K input; profile trusted model scores only
rule.graph: unchanged, graph objective change recorded after selection only; no universal veto
rule.marker_quality: 100/panel_size * (sum_f max(r_i) - 5*sum_f(sum(r_i)-max(r_i))); no lineage calibration or MAG quality threshold
rule.new_proposal: upper-median count over all observed reliable families (including singletons), >=2 families supporting K; single-copy-per-contig seed loci r>=.5; family with median count/highest mean reliability then lexical tie; longest opaque-ID order seeds; 10 deterministic sqrt-length-weighted spherical Lloyd iterations, no cannot-links/anchors/forced noise/reseeding
rule.physical_loci: same-contig genomic overlap >=.5*shorter span consolidated at max reliability; ambiguous multi-family genes remain recorded but unused; separate contigs never collapsed merely by matching family/protein
rule.selection: highest eligible weighted quality; numerical ties prefer more assigned bp then fewer children then retained route. Parent on no strict gain
